description: stplanr provides an R toolkit for reproducible transport planning, routing and analysis. The provider is rOpenSci stplanr contributors. Geographical and temporal coverage: The project originated in work for the Propensity to Cycle Tool and supports user-defined travel data. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): MIT. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The page establishes existence and purpose, but neither completeness nor fitness for a particular simulation was independently tested. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport route and demand analysis. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
